decisions.reason: As a flagship product line close to the core software business and publicly tied to the firm's digital direction, management is very likely to continue backing it and treat any shortcomings as temporary.
The remote support tool fits the firm's established support model and uses existing capabilities, so sunk development and operational fit make continued commitment likely.
The analytics dashboard supports the stated move toward connected and efficiently managed practices, and its visible launch makes management inclined to persist rather than reverse course quickly.
A complete practice bundle is very close to the firm's core offer and can be justified as a strategic packaging of existing strengths, so management would usually retain it.

Because the portal is more distant from the firm's established software business and was less visibly committed, management is more willing by 2022 to stop it and reallocate resources to core products and new development.
